subject: Critical serving degradation — customer-facing brief & next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Critical serving degradation — need customer-facing comms and owner

Team,

At ~08:55 UTC we observed a sudden spike in 5xx errors and tail latency for a subset of streaming requests routed through our hosted inference layer. Initial mitigation (rolling back a recent routing change) reduced error rates but several customers remain impacted, including CloudDeck (production).

Immediate asks:
- Neha: can you own the customer-facing update and outbound send (quick, factual, non-technical)?
- Aisha: please prepare a short status snapshot (error rates, affected models, time ranges) we can attach.
- Jonas: open a SUP ticket and capture the initial timeline; coordinate with infra for logs.

I want a short external note within 20–30 minutes. We'll collect logs for RCA but also need to set expectations with the customer on next update cadence and remediation ETA.

Attachments: incident-runbook.pdf (refer to step 2 for temp rollback guidance).

-Marcus
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Critical serving degradation — need customer-facing comms and owner

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team,
>
> At ~08:55 UTC we observed a sudden spike in 5xx errors...

I will take lead on the external communication. Draft below (short + timelines). Aisha, send the snapshot PNG; Jonas, please paste the SUP ticket once created. Marcus, I'll CC you on the outbound.

Draft outbound (to be pragmatic):
Subject: Redwood Inference — service impact affecting CloudDeck (status update)

Sara / CloudDeck ops team,

We’re investigating an issue affecting inference requests that may cause increased errors and latency for a subset of customers. Our engineers have identified the likely cause and applied an initial mitigation that has reduced error rates for most traffic. We continue to monitor and are actively working on a full remediation.

What we know now:
- Impact window: ~08:55 UTC — ongoing
- Scope: increased 5xx and higher latency for some requests; some CloudDeck production traffic affected
- Immediate mitigation: routing rollback performed at 09:00 UTC; partial recovery observed

Next updates:
- Short follow-up in 60 minutes with more detail and metrics
- RCA and full timeline within 72 hours

If you prefer a dedicated call, we can stand up a brief bridge.

We apologize for the disruption and will share a full timeline as we confirm root cause.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

P.S. I'll attach a status snapshot and include the SUP ticket ID once Jonas creates it.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Bradley <sara.bradley@clouddeck.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — service impact affecting CloudDeck (status update)

Sara,

Quick update from Redwood — we’re actively investigating an issue that began at ~08:55 UTC impacting inference requests. Our initial mitigation (routing rollback) reduced error rates but we know you may still be seeing errors for some production requests.

What we’ve done so far:
- Rolled back a recent routing change at 09:00 UTC (partial recovery observed)
- Engineers are streaming logs and tracing requests to identify any remaining symptomatic traffic

Immediate expectations:
- Next update in 60 minutes with metrics and SUP ticket ID
- We’ll provide a comprehensive RCA within 72 hours; if that timeline changes we’ll communicate immediately

If you’d like to jump on a quick call, we can stand up a short bridge and loop in engineering.

Attachments: status-snapshot.png (current error rate and latency charts)

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll keep you posted.

— Neha
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Bradley <sara.bradley@clouddeck.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@clouddeck.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — service impact affecting CloudDeck (status update)

Neha,

Thanks for the quick update and for rolling back the change. We’re still seeing increased errors on a small subset of endpoints; impact is intermittent but affecting a small % of production requests. Two asks from our side:

1) Please confirm estimated time to full restoration or when you’ll have a clearer ETA.
2) We’ll need a formal RCA and a note on SLA credits if this is classified as a SEV incident under our contract — can you confirm the process and timeline?

If helpful, we can join a short call now.

— Sara
Director of Platform Engineering
CloudDeck

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Follow-up: CloudDeck incident — customer comms, RCA timeline, and credits

Thanks team for the rapid response on Monday and for the clear external note. A couple of follow-ups as we transition from incident response to post-incident coordination:

1) RCA timeline: we owe CloudDeck an initial RCA draft within 72 hours of initial impact (target: Thu 2026-08-06 08:00 UTC). Please assemble the timeline, impacted services, and mitigation steps. Aisha, can you consolidate the metrics into incident-timeline.pdf and drop it in the Drive link?

2) SLA/credits: Legal & Finance will need a short summary of impact duration and affected throughput for credit calculation. Neha, please prepare a 1-paragraph impact summary we can send to finance. CloudDeck flagged credits in their reply — treat this as high priority.

3) Exec update: I’ll send a customer-facing executive note once we have the initial RCA draft. Keep the tone apologetic, factual, and include tangible next steps.

4) Follow-up items: SUP ticket SUP-1129 captures collector logs and mitigation timeline (link above). Jonas, please move the ticket to "postmortem" and add owners for each RCA section.

Attachments: customer-communication-draft.docx, incident-timeline.pdf (working).

We should aim to close the customer loop (initial RCA + credit guidance) within 72 hours. If any blockers surface, escalate to me immediately.

-Marcus
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
